verdict.rationale: Hightouch ships a built-in natural-language agent, so letting users connect external MCP servers to it is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only documents Hightouch's own MCP server, which exposes Hightouch tools to outside AI assistants. That is the server role, not the client capability this story asks about. Nothing shows users can register third-party MCP servers for Hightouch's agent to call.
